name: Calgary International Airport

runway.v: three runways: 17L/35R 4,267 m (14,000 ft), 17R/35L 3,863 m (12,675 ft), 11-29 2,438 m (8,000 ft); widths not given

slots.v: every runway user needs a pre-approved arrival and departure slot from the Airport Reservation Office, booked in the Online Coordination System (OCS) or through an FBO; requests open 72 hours ahead (30 days for YYC-based GA/BA tenants); on time = within plus or minus 30 minutes. Exempt: medevac, military, customs, police, head of state, helicopters, emergency diversions
slots.quote: All users of YYC's runways will require a pre-approved arrival and departure slot prior to operation.

customs.v: CBSA traveller service 24 hours, every day (airport of entry; US preclearance available)

notes: Runway lengths from the Calgary Airport Authority facts page (undated). Slots from the ARO page (undated); it does not name charters separately, so confirm with aro@yyc.com that a charter is treated as GA/BA. CBSA open data file offices-bureaux-en.csv is undated; the old CBSA office pages say the directory moved to a new cloud server on 31 Mar 2026, so confirm hours with CBSA before a trip. No official statement on night restrictions found: the noise management page and the 2026 Aviation Tariff (as at 1 Jan 2026) give no hours or curfew. FBO names not found on an official page. CFS not freely online; NAV CANADA ICAO Type A chart index (Oct 2026) lists CYYC runways but no lengths.
